[b]Intro[/b]
In the recent years a shocking and most disturbing trend has suffered in the nation of Rosenmarkke, which once a beacon of the liberal order and a champion of order and freedom, has seen itself destabilized and diminished both politically and internationally as the government seeks rapid centralism as an answer to a world of growing strife.

However, in their pursuit of centralism, the government has permitted many intolerable acts to occur within itself; namely: the increase of executive power, the cession of political control to the security administration, and the pursuit of popular narrative control amongst the citizenry. It is these three primary factors that have caused all other issues to appear.

Since the 1950s the nation of Rosenmarkke has degraded its legislature through various laws and agencies, removing the incentive to check the government by making it nigh impossible to properly regulate the states motions within and without. This is no more apparent than in the rise of the guardian state under the SCSID which is legally empowered to coup the state in order to maintain order, which while noble in practice, exhibits the danger of the SCSID turning against the government repeatedly as it did in 2005 and most recently in 2027. 

The prevailing power of the SCSID also allows it to influence the executive with the threat of a removal from power, thereby making the security system the executive and dimming the ability of the citizens and legislative to influence or place into power non-SCSID aligned figures.

This thusly turns the role of the citizen and the state in reverse, where it is now the state that can influence the citizen and the citizen is unable to hold them accountable, for fear of reprisal. In this manner the state can now feed the citizen what the citizen wishes to hear while slowly pulling the rug from beneath their feet, allowing the government to control the narrative.

This has occurred in the years of recent, with 2027-28 seeing the sudden explosion in the national media of the cult of Strømm, a clear attempt by the government to prop up a coup and hide the true nature of the plans of the regime, these being total control in the triumvirate and the sidelining of the legislative (shown further by the sudden downsizing of the old legislature from 300 or so to 150 members).

As a result of these alleged reforms for streamlining the government, the government failed to account for its aging armed forces and the security of Rosenmarkke itself, instead, placing itself in a position with its external grandstanding (which was merely propaganda to allow regime supporters to support external aggression and posturing), to be shaken into submission by foreign powers.

Thus is the rub of our tragic tale, for as of recently the Rosenmarkket navy now lies burnt out in dock, and its major military infrastructure unusable for anything but scrap metal. The recent war with Wuloosya and the Hochdeutsche has seen Rosenmarkket projection capabilities severely impacted, threatening the narrative of the great revolution, and the state itself. Furthermore with the SCSID leadership decapitated in their bunkers the engine of the state has been now removed, leaving only the people and the emergency mechanisms which now are scrambling to restore order in the face of a laughing world.

But, contrary to the pessimistic predictions of the various states that surround Rosenmarkke, namely those her enemy, the Elsyr Defense Union, there still exists a way out for by which I shall argue henceforth in the following papers. This being, the restoration of the historical union with our northern neighbor Montfleur.

Now one might perhaps give pause to such an idea, the consequences alone would disrupt the global economic order, where Montfleur has remained neutral for nearly a century and has interacted minimally with the external world beyond basic trade, Rosenmarkke has expanded its reach internationally, and is the head and member of several international organisations including the Thýven Hydronia Pact andThe Corridor Treaty Organisation. However, when one moves out the shock factor, they realise that such a union would be mutually beneficial if set up correctly, and even a restoration of the right order. 

It is thus with these reasons that I am in support of the unity of Montfleur and Rosenmarkke, for from it true peace on eastern Elseyr can be established.

- James Mjrkanlwyth (President of the International Association for the Reunification of Rosenmarkke and Montfleur)
